t: This was the home of Gainsborough Pictures, a British film studio on the south bank of the Regent's Canal, in Poole Street, Hoxton. The studio was active from 1924 to 1951. The company began at Islington Studios, which had been built as a power station for the Great Northern and City Railway before being converted. Gainsborough was founded by Michael Balcon, who later led Ealing Studios from 1938 to 1956, and who is remembered for guiding the young Alfred Hitchcock.
